title: Standing Committee on Health and Family Welfare: Ayush departments
body: A Standing Committee of Parliament on Health and Family Welfare reviewed the co-location of Ayush facilities at Primary Health Centres, Community Health Centres and District Hospitals. In its recommendation, the Committee noted that some states and Union Territories had not opened a separate Department of Ayush. To boost the Ayush system and improve coordination, it recommended that the Ministry of Ayush persuade those states and UTs to create such a department. In its 'Action Taken' reply, the Ministry stated that public health is a state subject, so creating a separate department lies with each State or UT government. It added that it had requested the states in various meetings to create separate directorates and deploy staff, and that a separate Ayush Directorate was by then available in 24 States/UTs.
